atoms.exact_source_text: The player enters through a specific available Citizen or inhabited Place.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player enters EMBODY through a specific available Citizen or inhabited Place.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each experience has an authored spatial pocket, a limited verb set, a beginning, a sensory turn, and a natural exit.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each EMBODY experience has an authored spatial pocket, limited verb set, beginning, sensory turn, and natural exit.

atoms.exact_source_text: Participation does not create exclusive food, materials, healing speed, or statistical advantage.
atoms.normalized_claim: Participation in EMBODY does not create exclusive food, materials, healing speed, or statistical advantage.

atoms.exact_source_text: The experience is valuable because the Citizen’s life is valuable.
atoms.normalized_claim: The EMBODY experience is valuable because the Citizen's life is valuable.

atoms.exact_source_text: There is no requirement to repeat EMBODY for every Citizen.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no requirement to repeat EMBODY for every Citizen.

atoms.exact_source_text: It must not become a daily recovery chore or a superior way to process routine work.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY must not become a daily recovery chore or a superior way to process routine work.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player supplies attention and limited motion.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player supplies attention and limited motion in EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Citizen retains expressive ownership: posture, reaction, temperament, and exact social response.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Citizen retains expressive ownership over posture, reaction, temperament, and exact social response.

atoms.exact_source_text: The same colony geometry that matters in DWELL must produce a distinct physical fantasy in EMBODY.
atoms.normalized_claim: The same colony geometry that matters in DWELL must produce a distinct physical fantasy in EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: A session may enter Campaign Memory when it contains a distinctive Citizen, Place, relationship, recent event, or sensory conjunction.
atoms.normalized_claim: A session may enter Campaign Memory when it contains a distinctive Citizen, Place, relationship, recent event, or sensory conjunction.
Most EMBODY sessions may remain ephemeral.

atoms.exact_source_text: EMBODY is a globally available Register within Home Mode.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY is a globally available Register within Home Mode.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is not keyed to a selected Citizen’s Role Margin, personal recovery meter, or special unlock.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY is not keyed to a selected Citizen's Role Margin, personal recovery meter, or special unlock.

atoms.exact_source_text: The colony’s current state determines whether embodiment is possible at all
atoms.normalized_claim: The colony's current state determines whether embodiment is possible at all.

atoms.exact_source_text: the selected Citizen determines which experiences are available.
atoms.normalized_claim: The selected Citizen determines which EMBODY experiences are available.
